svg.title: Lord of Sorrow: Three of Swords · Saturn in Libra · Binah (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Saturn above the painting and Libra below, as Book T places them: "Above and below the central sword are the symbols of Saturn and Libra." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1791653375363-et0z30fakwg.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0).
